Introduction

KAWANARI (short for Kawaku naritai!, meaning "I want to be cute!" in Japanese) was a South Korean live idol duo composed of Myai and Moka. They debuted on March 19, 2023, under IMU Production as a trio with Moka, Nako, and Chiyo. Chiyo left shortly after debut for academic reasons, and the group became a duo.

Later, in 2023, they became independent and added Myai, returning to a trio. Nako went on hiatus in early 2024, during which Myai and Moka appeared on Girls Frontier. Moka later left the show to focus on the group. In June 2024, Erina briefly joined and participated in their first single, “Level Up!” before graduating in August. Nako officially left in December 2024.

KAWANARI announced their disbandment on February 20, 2025, with their final day as a group on March 30, 2025. Afterward, Myai joined the group REKIREM, and Moka pursued solo activities.
